preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a weight between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations required is non-negative.
After performing the minimum number of operations, the MST is unique and its cost remains unchanged.
